Explore the working process

Before we begin

A few things
you may be wondering.

Is this right for my first website?

Yes. We can start by defining the essentials: your services, your audience and the action visitors should take. Existing branding and content are useful, but we first agree what is available and what still needs to be prepared.

Can we replace an existing website?

We can review what you have and discuss the changes you need. Content, account access, hosting and migration requirements need to be understood before the work is scoped.

How much will it cost, and how long will it take?

That depends on the agreed pages, content and functionality. We confirm a project fee and schedule after understanding the brief. Content preparation and review stages are included in that discussion.

Will I be able to update my website?

We discuss what you want to edit and how often before selecting the platform. Editing access, instructions and any support requirements are part of the agreed scope.

Do you also offer ongoing care?

Yes, by agreement. Website care is optional and has a defined scope. Read about website care.
